question: According to the Jujutsu Kaisen wiki, who is taller, Yuta Okkotsu or Megumi Fushiguro? Give both heights.
answer:
**Yuta Okkotsu is taller.** He is almost 180 cm (almost 5'11"), and Megumi Fushiguro is 175 cm (5'9").

Source: the height fields in the infoboxes on the Jujutsu Kaisen Wiki pages for [Yuta Okkotsu](https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Yuta_Okkotsu) and [Megumi Fushiguro](https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Megumi_Fushiguro). I read them from the local KB, which was last synced 2026-11-24.
